$description: Contextual Workspace capability navigation. The Capability Capsule is one bounded, internally scrolling horizontal row of fixed-geometry entries. Only capabilities with a Workspace view and visible lifecycle presence receive navigation slots; unavailable/hidden capabilities do not reserve dead chrome (#1455). Each capability owns a full title and, when that title exceeds the compact identity limit, an explicit shortTitle of at most eight user-visible grapheme clusters (#1458). The Capsule renders the compact title while preserving the full accessible identity. Selection belongs to the entry surface itself: active/inactive/hover may change semantic foreground/background only, never entry geometry, typography, icon geometry, label geometry, or Capsule height. There is no selected dot/badge/underline. Web uses horizontal icon+label composition inside the canonical control.md band; App may use icon-over-label inside its own control.md band. The navigation row itself remains one horizontal row; the contract still permits label wrapping inside a fixed slot, while the shipped compact-title recipe is stricter and renders one line. Capability count changes horizontal scroll extent only.
